title: Drunk Florida Dad Nearly Blacks Out While Driving Kid to School
description:
A Florida father was caught on body cameras after allegedly driving a child to school while drunk. Police took Jorge Gutierrez Gonzalez, 36, into custody after saying he fled from officers who tried to stop him when he attempted to drop a child off at school. But it wouldn’t be long until the 36-year-old was pulled from his vehicle and arrested for DUI and more. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
